Assemble the HAC covariance for a (method, design) pair

Source: R/variance.R
dot-assemble_Sigma.Rd

Assembles the d x d HAC covariance for the supplied contribution matrix V, following the variance rule for the (method, design) pair:

  • crn: \(\hat\Sigma_2 = V^\top K_3^+ V\) (Theorem var_2, any design);

  • mrn / iptw, Bernoulli: Loewner max of the within- and overlap-kernel covariances (Theorem var_1);

  • mrn / iptw, complete: the Bernoulli value minus the bias-correction matrix \(\hat M\) (Section 6.3).

Usage

.assemble_Sigma(V, A, C, W_C, method, design)

Arguments

V

n_unit x d contribution matrix.

A

n_unit x n_unit adjacency matrix (with self-loops).

C

integer vector of cluster ids.

W_C

0/1 vector of cluster-level treatments.

method

"mrn", "iptw" or "crn".

design

"bernoulli" or "complete".

Value

A list with the d x d matrix Sigma and a describing string variance_type.

Examples

set.seed(1)
A <- Matrix::Matrix(outer(1:12, 1:12, function(i, j) abs(i - j) <= 1) * 1,
                    sparse = TRUE)
C <- rep(1:3, each = 4); W_C <- c(1, 0, 1)
V <- matrix(rnorm(24), 12, 2) / 12   # contributions of two estimands
generalClusterExp:::.assemble_Sigma(V, A, C, W_C,
                                    method = "mrn", design = "bernoulli")
#> $Sigma
#>            [,1]       [,2]
#> [1,] 0.08862573 0.04373699
#> [2,] 0.04373699 0.08922703
#> 
#> $variance_type
#> [1] "var_1 (Loewner-max, Bernoulli)"
#> 
generalClusterExp:::.assemble_Sigma(V, A, C, W_C,
                                    method = "crn", design = "bernoulli")
#> $Sigma
#>            [,1]       [,2]
#> [1,] 0.09709699 0.03503498
#> [2,] 0.03503498 0.21256676
#> 
#> $variance_type
#> [1] "var_2 (K3+)"
#>
